events.title: Cooly Rocks On 2026 – Final Day
events.description: The final days of Australia’s largest nostalgia festival celebrating 1950s–70s music, classic cars, dancing, and vintage culture, with live music, markets, and car displays continuing into the precinct on Sunday.

events.title: James Alexander’s Soul Sundays
events.description: An ongoing weekly live music series featuring James Alexander performing soul-influenced sets, attracting a regular local crowd for a grassroots music social scene on Sunday evenings.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart – Exhibition
events.location: Gold Coast Gallery, Surfers Paradise/Southport precinct
events.description: A contemporary art exhibition by Aka Sorbie exploring coastal and saltwater themes, open daily as part of a longer program running through mid-July.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from White Rabbit Collection
events.location: Major Gold Coast Gallery (likely HOTA), Surfers Paradise/Southport precinct
events.description: A curated exhibition showcasing key works from Sydney’s renowned White Rabbit Collection of Chinese contemporary art, presented on the Gold Coast through July and open daily this week.

events.title: Koi Sunset Sessions
events.location: Coastal Venue, Broadbeach/Surfers Paradise coastal area
events.description: Ongoing daily sunset music sessions combining DJ or acoustic sets with drinks in a relaxed coastal setting, operating as a recurring social scene for locals and visitors through the winter months.

events.title: Comedy Underground
events.location: Comedy Club/Bar, Surfers Paradise or Broadbeach
events.description: A weekly Saturday stand-up comedy night showcasing local and touring comedians in an intimate underground bar setting, part of a long-running series.

events.title: Seafood Sundays at Maggie Choo
events.location: Maggie Choo, Surfers Paradise or Broadbeach
events.description: A weekly seafood-focused social event at Maggie Choo, combining dining with a bar atmosphere, popular with locals for end-of-week socialising in a relaxed setting.
